title: browser-use/video-use
title_zh: 视频-use：编辑视频的编码代理

paragraphs.en: Introducing video-use — edit videos with Claude Code. 100% open source.
paragraphs.zh: 推出 video-use —— 使用 Claude Code 编辑视频。100% 开源。

paragraphs.en: Drop raw footage in a folder, chat with Claude Code, get final.mp4 back. Works for any content — talking heads, montages, tutorials, travel, interviews — without presets or menus.
paragraphs.zh: 把原始素材丢进文件夹，与 Claude Code 智能体对话，就能拿回最终的 mp4 文件。 适用于任何内容——口播、混剪、教程、旅行、访谈——无需预设或菜单。

paragraphs.en: Paste into Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Openclaw, or any agent with shell access:
paragraphs.zh: 粘贴到 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、Openclaw 或任何具有 shell 访问权限的智能体中：

paragraphs.en: Set up https://github.com/browser-use/video-use for me. Read install.md first to install this repo, wire up ffmpeg, register the skill with whichever agent you're running under, and set up the ElevenLabs API key — ask me to paste it when you need it. Then read SKILL.md for daily usage, and always read helpers/ because that's where the editing scripts live. After install, don't transcribe anything on your own — just tell me it's ready and wait for me to drop footage into a folder. The agent handles the clone, dependencies, skill registration, and prompts you once for your ElevenLabs API key (grab one at elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys ).
paragraphs.zh: 请为我设置 https://github.com/browser-use/video-use。 先阅读 install.md 来安装这个仓库，配置好 ffmpeg，向你当前运行的智能体注册该技能，并设置 ElevenLabs API 密钥——需要时请让我粘贴密钥。 然后阅读 SKILL.md 了解日常用法，并务必阅读 helpers/ 目录，因为编辑脚本都存放在那里。 安装完成后，不要自行转录任何内容——只需告诉我已准备就绪，然后等我把素材放进文件夹。 该智能体会处理克隆、依赖项、技能注册，并只提示你输入一次 ElevenLabs API 密钥（可在 elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys 获取）。

paragraphs.en: It inventories the sources, proposes a strategy, waits for your OK, then produces edit/final.mp4 next to your sources. All outputs live in <videos_dir>/edit/ — the skill directory stays clean.
paragraphs.zh: 它会清点素材来源、提出剪辑方案、等待你确认，然后在你的素材目录旁边生成 edit/final.mp4。 所有输出都保存在 <videos_dir>/edit/ 中——技能目录保持整洁。

paragraphs.en: # 1. Clone and symlink into your agent's skills directory git clone https://github.com/browser-use/video-use ~ /Developer/video-use ln -sfn ~ /Developer/video-use ~ /.claude/skills/video-use # Claude Code # ln -sfn ~/Developer/video-use ~/.codex/skills/video-use # Codex # 2. Install deps cd ~ /Developer/video-use uv sync # or: pip install -e . brew install ffmpeg # required brew install yt-dlp # optional, for downloading online sources # 3. Add your ElevenLabs API key cp .env.example .env $EDITOR .env # ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=... How it works The LLM never watches the video. It reads it — through two layers that together give it everything it needs to cut with word-boundary precision.
paragraphs.zh: # 1. 克隆仓库并用符号链接放入你的智能体的 skills 目录 git clone https://github.com/browser-use/video-use ~/Developer/video-use ln -sfn ~/Developer/video-use ~/.claude/skills/video-use # Claude Code # ln -sfn ~/Developer/video-use ~/.codex/skills/video-use # Codex # 2. 安装依赖 cd ~/Developer/video-use uv sync # 或者：pip install -e . brew install ffmpeg # 必需 brew install yt-dlp # 可选，用于下载在线视频源 # 3. 添加你的 ElevenLabs API 密钥 cp .env.example .env $EDITOR .env # ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=... 工作原理 大语言模型从不观看视频。 它通过两层机制来「读取」视频——这两层机制共同为它提供剪辑所需的全部信息，达到词边界级别的精确度。

sents.en: How it works The LLM never watches the video.
sents.zh: 工作原理 大语言模型从不观看视频。

sents.en: It reads it — through two layers that together give it everything it needs to cut with word-boundary precision.
sents.zh: 它通过两层机制来「读取」视频——这两层机制共同为它提供剪辑所需的全部信息，达到词边界级别的精确度。

paragraphs.en: Layer 1 — Audio transcript (always loaded). One ElevenLabs Scribe call per source gives word-level timestamps, speaker diarization, and audio events ( (laughter) , (applause) , (sigh) ). All takes pack into a single ~12KB takes_packed.md — the LLM's primary reading view.
paragraphs.zh: 第一层——音频转写文本（始终加载）。 每个源文件调用一次 ElevenLabs Scribe，可获得词级时间戳、说话人分离以及音频事件（(笑声)、(掌声)、(叹气)）。 所有素材打包进单个约 12KB 的 takes_packed.md——这是大语言模型的主要阅读视图。

paragraphs.en: ## C0103 (duration: 43.0s, 8 phrases) [002.52-005.36] S0 Ninety percent of what a web agent does is completely wasted. [006.08-006.74] S0 We fixed this. Layer 2 — Visual composite (on demand). timeline_view produces a filmstrip + waveform + word labels PNG for any time range. Called only at decision points — ambiguous pauses, retake comparisons, cut-point sanity checks.
paragraphs.zh: ## C0103（时长：43.0秒，8个短语）[002.52-005.36] S0 网页智能体所做的事情中有百分之九十是完全被浪费掉的。 [006.08-006.74] S0 我们修复了这个问题。 第2层——视觉合成（按需）。timeline_view 可为任意时间范围生成包含胶片条+波形+词语标签的 PNG 图像。 仅在决策点调用——用于模糊停顿、重录对比和剪切点合理性检查。

sents.en: ## C0103 (duration: 43.0s, 8 phrases) [002.52-005.36] S0 Ninety percent of what a web agent does is completely wasted.

sents.en: [006.08-006.74] S0 We fixed this.
Layer 2 — Visual composite (on demand). timeline_view produces a filmstrip + waveform + word labels PNG for any time range.
sents.zh: 第2层——视觉合成（按需）。timeline_view 可为任意时间范围生成包含胶片条+波形+词语标签的 PNG 图像。

sents.en: Called only at decision points — ambiguous pauses, retake comparisons, cut-point sanity checks.
sents.zh: 仅在决策点调用——用于模糊停顿、重录对比和剪切点合理性检查。

paragraphs.en: Naive approach: 30,000 frames × 1,500 tokens = 45M tokens of noise . Video Use: 12KB text + a handful of PNGs .
paragraphs.zh: 朴素做法：30,000 帧 × 1,500 个 token = 4,500 万个 token 的噪声。 Video Use：12KB 文本 + 少量 PNG 图像。

sents.zh: 朴素做法：30,000 帧 × 1,500 个 token = 4,500 万个 token 的噪声。

sents.en: Video Use: 12KB text + a handful of PNGs .
sents.zh: Video Use：12KB 文本 + 少量 PNG 图像。

paragraphs.en: Same idea as browser-use giving an LLM a structured DOM instead of a screenshot — but for video.
paragraphs.zh: 和 browser-use 给大语言模型提供结构化 DOM 而非截图的思路相同——只不过这里是针对视频的。

paragraphs.en: Transcribe ──> Pack ──> LLM Reasons ──> EDL ──> Render ──> Self-Eval │ └─ issue? fix + re-render (max 3) The self-eval loop runs timeline_view on the rendered output at every cut boundary — catches visual jumps, audio pops, hidden subtitles. You see the preview only after it passes.
paragraphs.zh: 转录 ──> 打包 ──> LLM 推理 ──> EDL ──> 渲染 ──> 自评估 │ └─ 有问题？修复并重新渲染（最多 3 次）该自评估循环在每个剪辑边界对渲染输出运行 timeline_view —— 可以捕捉视觉跳变、音频爆音和隐藏的字幕。 只有通过自评估后，你才能看到预览。
